top_deficiency_types.title: Let each resident or the resident's legal representative access or purchase copies of all the resident's records.
Provide the required documentation or notification related to the resident's needs, appeal rights, or bed-hold policies.
Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Honor the resident's right to a dignified existence, self-determination, communication, and to exercise his or her rights.
Provide medically-related social services to help each resident achieve the highest possible quality of life.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure drugs and biologicals used in the facility are labeled in accordance with currently accepted professional principles; and all drugs and biologicals must be stored in locked compartments, separately locked, compartments for controlled drugs.
Ensure each resident receives and the facility provides food prepared in a form designed to meet individual needs.
Add doors in an exit area that do not require the use of a key from the exit side unless in case of special locking arrangements.
Have approved installation, maintenance and testing program for fire alarm systems.
Have posted "No-smoking" signs in areas where smoking is not permitted or ashtrays provided where smoking was allowed.
